question: Which declared source conditions select the local E8 boundary reconstruction, which hypercharge must its auxiliary vectorlike singlet pair carry, and can its complementary determinant generate a relative Down/lepton phase?
kills: Neutrality and minimal characteristic norm alone uniquely select the named interaction in the fixed channel basis.
The first three positive entries of the supplied n are the A3 family coordinates in the fixed D5+A3 dictionary.
The construction must single out one original color coordinate or use the longer six-plus-two composite to obtain a pure weight-one spinor.
Conditional relevance at a co-built velocity matrix derives that velocity or the physical source from P1/P2.
A hypercharge-zero vectorlike singlet auxiliary pair preserves the stated original hypercharge and proposed null interaction.
A common factorized massive determinant by itself generates a relative Down/lepton phase.
Writing a constant free Dirac mass with a complex phase produces a phase-dependent flat-background finite Matsubara determinant.

summary_de: Bedingte Auswahl 84->56->2->1 und symmetrischer lokaler Quartikvertreter. Das vorgegebene TFPT-Hyperladungswoerterbuch erzwingt fuer ein vektorartiges Singulett-Zusatzpaar y=1. Ein gemeinsamer massiver Faktor kuerzt sich aus der relativen Down-/Leptonphase; eine konstante komplexe Diracmassenschreibweise liefert im flachen freien Modenkern keine Phase. Der geschlossene endliche Vierquellenvergleich .28 wird als vorhandenes Resultat beruecksichtigt, nicht als erneut ausgefuehrt. Die gemeinsame physische Quellenabbildung bleibt offen.
